Description.en:
Try multiple times, follow the clues,
and crack the plant-codes!

And don't forget right-clicking to clear a slot!

 You'll earn gems the first time you decode and succeed each day!

The fewer attempts you make, or the more complex the password is, 
the greater the reward will be!
Description.zh:
多次尝试，解读线索，
破解植物密码！
别忘了右键可以清除卡槽！
每天第一次解码并成功可以获得钻石奖励！
尝试越少，或密码越复杂，奖励越丰厚！
